title: Interview: Sales staffing and expert routing
story: You meet Lina, the retail sales manager at Contoso. She wants new order callers to reach true experts and for the Sales queue to have enough people.
You will ask Lina what she needs, then make the changes in the Contoso test environment.

interview.opening: We must make sure new order calls go to experts and we have enough people on the Sales queue.

topics.ask: Do we need more staff on the Sales queue to handle order calls?
topics.answer: Yes. Right now we are short. I want at least four people on Sales so calls don’t pile up.

topics.ask: Could we cover peak times with our current team?
topics.answer: Not reliably. Hire or assign one more so we have four agents available on Sales.

topics.ask: Should the Sales IVR option go only to senior reps?
topics.answer: Absolutely. New order callers need an expert on the line, not a trainee.

topics.ask: How many experts should be available for the Sales option?
topics.answer: Make sure four people on Sales are marked as Expert for the Sales skill.

extras.ask: Do you want to change the IVR prompt for Sales?
extras.answer: No, the prompt is fine — focus on the people who get the calls.

extras.ask: Should callers get callback options if wait is long?
extras.answer: We can look at that later. For now, fix staffing and expert routing.
